title: arenaria tetraquetra var. tejedensis
intro: Arenaria tetraquetra var. tejedensis, commonly known as Spanish sea spurrey, is a plant species belonging to the Caryophyllaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include acting as a bronchodilator, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant, which contribute to its overall health benefits. The bioactive constituents of Arenaria tetraquetra var. tejedensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
